references.context: Complete the T-A-G drop targets from left to right, then shoot the lit upper-left lock saucer.
references.label: Upper-left lock saucer
references.description: Saucer used for the first lock and again during Multiball.

references.context: Complete the lower-right T-E-A-M drop targets in order, then shoot the lit lower-right lock saucer.
references.label: Lower-right lock saucer
references.description: Saucer used for the second lock.

references.context: After both balls are locked, shoot the left Release horseshoe to start three-ball Multiball and 3x playfield scoring.
references.label: Release horseshoe
references.description: Left-side horseshoe that releases the locked balls.

references.context: During Multiball, roll through the left return lane to light the right spinner, then shoot the lit spinner for 30,000 per spin.
references.label: Left return lane
references.description: Return lane that lights the right spinner.

references.context: During Multiball, roll through the left return lane to light the right spinner, then shoot the lit spinner for 30,000 per spin.
references.label: Right spinner
references.description: Spinner worth 30,000 per spin during Multiball when lit.

references.context: Still during Multiball, use the right flipper to shoot the upper-left lock saucer. After its kickout, shoot the gate to the top lanes, then roll through each lit top lane to turn it off.
references.label: Gate to the top lanes
references.description: Gate reached after the upper-left lock-saucer kickout.
